Why are the priests to be consulted to settle disputes involving injuries?
The priests are to be consulted and their decision to be accepted because Yahweh has chosen them to serve him in this way.
What ritual must the elders of the city nearest to the killed man perform so that this murder will be forgiven?
The elders of that city must wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken and declare that the people did not do this murder and Yahweh will not consider them guilty.
What is an Israelite man to do if he sees a woman among the captives who he wants as his wife?

If a man sees a woman among the captives who he wants as his wife, he is to bring her home where she will shave her head, cut her nails, and change her clothes. He is to give her a month to mourn for her parents and then he can marry her.
How is an Israelite man to treat a captive that he had taken as a wife if he is no longer pleased with her?
He must let her go rather than sell her for money.
If a man has two wives, and he favors the one who has borne him his firstborn son, how must he distribute his inheritance?
This man must recognize the firstborn son of the wife he does not favor by giving him a double portion of all that he possesses.
What must the parents of a rebellious son do if the son will not obey them?
They must bring that rebellious son to the elders of the city.
What must the parents of the rebellious son say to the elders of his city?
The parents of the rebellious son must tell the elders that their son is stubborn and rebellious and does not listen to them.
Why must the men of the city respond by stoning the son to death?
They must stone the son to death to remove the evil from among them, and cause all Israel to hear of it and fear.
What must happen if a man commits a sin worthy of death and is hanged on a tree?
The man’s body must not remain all night on the tree, but must be buried the same day so the land will not be defiled.
What are they to do when they would see a stray animal of a fellow Israelite?

They are to return the animal to its owner. If the owner is not nearby or they do not know who he is, they should take the animal to their own house until the owner comes searching for it and then return it to him.
What did Moses tell them to do when they see an animal of a fellow Israelite fallen down in the road?
They must help their fellow Israelite lift it up again.
What is an abomination to Yahweh?
It is an abomination to Yahweh for a woman to wear men’s clothing or a man to wear women’s clothing.
What should the people of Israel do if they find a mother in a bird’s nest with her young or sitting on the eggs?
They must let the mother go, but the young they may take for themselves.
What is required when an Israelite builds a house?
It is required that he put a railing around the roof so he would not be guilty of causing someone’s death if anyone fell from it.
What would happen if the Israelites plant their vineyards with two kinds of seeds?
If they plant their vineyards with two kinds of seeds, all the produce of the seed and the yield of the vineyard would have to be set apart.
What were the Israelites instructed to make for the four corners of their garments?
They were instructed to make tassels for the four corners of the garments with which they covered themselves.
What must happen if a man has made a false accusation against his wife saying she was not a virgin?
The elders of the city must punish the man. They must fine him 100 silvers and give it to the girl’s father. Also, she shall remain his wife, and he can never send her away.
What should happen if the proof of the wife’s virginity is not found?
If they cannot find proof of her virginity, then she must be brought out and stoned to death because she has done a disgraceful thing.
What must happen if a man is found lying with a woman married to another man?
Both the man and the woman must be put to death to make sure no one else from Israel does this evil action.
Why are the people of Israel instructed to stone to death both a girl who is engaged to a man and another man if they are found lying together?
They are instructed to stone both of them because the girl did not cry out and the man defiled the one who is engaged to be the wife of a fellow Israelite.
What must happen if the man forces the engaged girl to lie with him when they are out in a field?

If this happens out in a field, then the man must die, but nothing must be done to the girl because he found her out in the open countryside and even though she cried out, there was no one there to rescue her.
What must happen if a man lies with a girl who is a virgin, but who is not engaged and they are discovered?
The man who lay with her must give 50 silvers to the girl’s father, and she shall become his wife and he may never divorce her.
What must a man not take from his father as his own?
A man must not take his father’s wife as his own.
Who is not allowed to enter the assembly of Yahweh?
A man whose male organ is crushed or cut off, or a child from intermarriage and that person’s descendants to the tenth generation, are not allowed to enter the assembly of Yahweh.
Why are Ammonites and Moabites not allowed to enter the assembly of Yahweh?
They are not allowed to enter because they did not provide the Israelites with food and water when the Israelites came out of Egypt, and because they hired Balaam to curse the Israelites.
What evidence showed that Yahweh did not listen to Balaam?
Yahweh turned Balaam’s curse into a blessing for Israel.
Why should they not detest the Edomites and Egyptians?

They are not to detest the Edomites because they are considered relatives of the Israelites as they are descendants of Isaac. The Egyptians should not be detested because the Israelites once lived as foreigners in Egypt.
If a man in the Israelite army becomes unclean because of what happens during the night, what must he do to become clean and return to the camp?
He must go outside the camp until evening. Then he must bathe in water, and at sunset he can return to the camp.
Why did Yahweh give instructions to the people of Israel about where and how to relieve themselves?
Yahweh was walking in the midst of their camp, so the camp must be holy in order that Yahweh would not see any unclean thing and turn away from them.
What are the instructions concerning a slave who escapes from their master?
Such a slave is not to be returned to their master. They are to be allowed to live among the Israelites in any town they choose, and they must not be mistreated.
Why were male and female cultic prostitutes not allowed among the Israelites, and why were their earnings not allowed to be brought as a vow into Yahweh’s house?
These practices and the earnings from them are considered an abomination to Yahweh.
How is the policy for charging interest different for fellow Israelites compared to foreigners?
Israelites are not to charge interest to other Israelites on loans of money, food, or anything else. However, they are allowed to charge interest to foreigners.
How important is it for an Israelite to fulfill a vow made to Yahweh?
It is very important. An Israelite must not delay in fulfilling a vow made to Yahweh because Yahweh requires it, and failing to do so is a sin. They must do what they have voluntarily promised.
What are Israelites allowed to do when passing through a neighbor’s vineyard or grain field?

When in a neighbor’s vineyard, they are allowed to eat as many grapes as they want but not to put any in a container to take with them. When in a neighbor’s grain field, they are allowed to pluck ears of grain by hand but not to use a sickle to cut the stalks.
What can a man who finds some indecent thing in his wife do to divorce her?
If a man has found some indecent thing in his wife, he can write her a letter of divorce, give the paper to her, and send her out of his house where she can go and become another man’s wife.
What does Yahweh not allow if the second husband writes her a letter of divorce and sends her out of the house or if he dies?
Yahweh does not allow for the first husband who sent her away to take her again to be his wife.
What are the benefits for a man who has taken a new wife?
He does not have to go to war or be commanded to go on forced duty, but he can stay home for one year to make his new wife happy.
Why were they not allowed to take a mill or an upper millstone as a pledge from another?
They were not to take a millstone as a pledge because it would be taking a man’s livelihood away from him.
What are the circumstances when a man would be declared a thief and must die?
A man would be declared a thief who must die if he kidnaps a fellow Israelite and treats him as a slave or sells him.
What word of caution from Yahweh about leprosy did Moses pass on to the people of Israel?
Moses told them to carefully observe and follow every instruction which Yahweh gave to the priests regarding any plague of leprosy.
What restrictions were given when collecting a pledge on a loan made to a neighbor?
They were not to go into the house to get the pledge, but stand outside and wait for the man who received the loan to bring out the pledge.
What must happen if a man gives his cloak as a pledge because he is a poor man?

If the poor man gives his cloak as a pledge for a loan, the one who gives him the loan must not keep the cloak overnight, but must take it back to him by the time the sun goes down so he may sleep in his cloak.
What must they do for a hired servant who is poor and needy?
They must give him his wages every day because he is poor and is counting on it.
How did Yahweh make it clear that everyone was responsible for their own sins?
Yahweh told the people of Israel that the parents must not be put to death for the sins of their children and the children must not be put to death for the sins of their parents.
Why were the people of Israel reminded about their time of slavery in Egypt and how Yahweh rescued them from there?
They were reminded so that they would follow Yahweh’s commands about how to treat foreigners, orphans, and widows.
What were the people of Israel commanded to do when they harvested their field or shook their olive tree?

When they harvested their crops, they were not to go back for a forgotten sheaf in the field or to beat their olive tree a second time to get more olives, but to leave them for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
What will a judge do when he reaches a judgement in a dispute between two men in court?
He will declare the righteous as innocent and declare the wicked as guilty.
Why will a judge limit the number of blows a man will receive?
The judge will order the number of blows to not exceed 40 blows so the man will not be humiliated.
What safeguard did Yahweh institute so that the name of a man would not disappear from Israel?
If a man dies without having a son, his brother must take the dead man’s widow as his wife so that the firstborn she bears will carry on the name of that man’s dead brother.
What punishment did Yahweh allow if the man’s brother did not wish to take his brother’s wife?
The brother’s wife will take off his sandal in the presence of the elders, spit in his face, and tell him that this is what is done when a man refuses to preserve his brother’s family line.
What would cause a wife to have one of her hands cut off?
If two men were fighting and the wife of one of the men grabs the private part of the other man in an attempt to rescue her husband, then her hand must be cut off.
What kind of dishonest act is disgusting to Yahweh?
It is disgusting to Yahweh when a man has a large and a small weight to measure rather than a correct weight.
Why must the people of Israel wipe out the memory of Amalek?
Amalek did not honor God when Amalek met Israel on the road and attacked those who were faint and weary at the rear as they came out of Egypt.
What must the people of Israel do when they possess the land which Yahweh has given them?
The people of Israel must take some of the first of all the harvest of the land in a basket and go to the place Yahweh has chosen for them to worship.
What must they say to the priest when they give him the basket?
They must tell the priest that they declare to Yahweh that they have come and settled in the land that he swore to give to their ancestors.
What must they say about their ancestor?
The people of Israel must say that their ancestor was a wandering Aramean.
How did the Egyptians treat the Israelites when they were in Egypt?
The Egyptians treated the Israelites badly and afflicted them, making them do the work of slaves.
How did Yahweh bring Israel out of Egypt?
He brought them out with a mighty hand, with a display of his great fearsome power, with signs, and with wonders.
What is the purpose for setting down the basket before Yahweh?
The purpose is to worship Yahweh and rejoice in all the good that he has done for Israel, their families, the Levites, and the foreigners among them.
What must they do after they have finished giving all the tithe from their harvest?
They must give it to the Levites, to the foreigners, to the orphans, and to the widows so they may eat and be filled.
What do the people of Israel want Yahweh to do for them?
The people of Israel want Yahweh to look down from heaven and bless them and the land which he has given to them.
What is Yahweh commanding the people to do?
He is commanding them to obey his statues and decrees with all their heart and soul.
What have the people declared before Yahweh?
They have declared that Yahweh is their God and that they will walk in his ways, keep his commandments, and listen to and obey all that he tells them to do.
What has Yahweh declared to the people of Israel?

Yahweh has declared that Israel is his own possession and he will set them high above all the other nations in respect to praise, reputation, and honor so they will be a people that is set apart and holy to him.
What did Moses and the elders of Israel command the people of Israel to keep?
Moses and the elders of Israel told the people to keep all the commandments that Moses had given them that day.
What were the people to do after they cross the Jordan River to the land which Yahweh would give them?
They were to erect some large stones covered with plaster.
What must the people build on Mount Ebal?
The people must build an altar of stone to Yahweh without using iron tools to sacrifice burnt offerings to him.
What were the people to write on the stones they had plastered?
They were to write all the words of the law on the stones very plainly.
Why was it important for the people of Israel to hear the voice of Yahweh and obey his commandments that day?
It was important because on that day they became the people of Yahweh.
Why were six of the tribes of Israel commanded to stand on Mount Gerizim?
Moses told them that six of the tribes of Israel must stand on Mount Gerizim to receive the blessings that the Levites proclaimed.
Why were six of the tribes of Israel commanded to stand on Mount Ebal?
Moses told them that the other six tribes of Israel must stand on Mount Ebal to receive the curses that the Levites proclaimed.
What is one thing that is detestable to Yahweh?
One thing that is detestable to Yahweh is a carved or cast figure made by a craftsman who sets it up to worship it in secret.
Why is a man cursed if he lies with his father’s wife?
A man is cursed if he sleeps with his father’s wife, because he has violated his father’s marriage rights.
What did the Levites say would happen to the man who secretly kills his neighbor or takes a bribe to kill an innocent person?
That the man would be cursed.
Why did the Levites say a man should keep the words of this law by obeying them?
A man should obey the words of this law so he would not be cursed.
What did the people of Israel have to do in order to be blessed by Yahweh and to be set above all the other nations of the earth?
The people of Israel needed to listen carefully to the voice of Yahweh and obey all his commandments.
What will Yahweh do for the people of Israel if they will obey his commandments?
Yahweh will enable them to defeat their enemies.
What does Moses tell the people of Israel they will become if they obey Yahweh’s commandments?
Yahweh will establish them as his own holy people.
What will Yahweh do for the people of Israel if they will obey his commandments?
Yahweh will send rain for their land at the right time and bless all their work.
What will happen to the people of Israel if they will not listen to the voice of Yahweh and keep all his commandments?
All the curses will come upon them.
What will happen to the skies and the earth if the Israelites do not obey the commandments?
The skies will not give rain and the earth will be as dry and hard as iron.
What will happen to Israel when they fight their enemies if they do not obey the commandments?
They will flee from their enemies and be defeated by them.
What will Yahweh cause to happen to the people of Israel if they are disobedient?
He will cause them to have boils, ulcers, rash, and itch, as well as madness, blindness, and mental confusion.
What will happen if an Israelite is betrothed to a woman, builds a house, or plants a vineyard but disobeys Yahweh?
Another man will rape his betrothed and he will not be able to live in the house or enjoy the fruit of the vineyard.
What will happen to the sons and daughters of the Israelites if they disobey Yahweh?
Their sons and daughters will be given to other peoples and they will not return to them.
What will the people of Israel become among all the peoples?
They will become a horror, a proverb, and a taunt among all the peoples.
How will the disobedience of the people of Israel affect the crops which they plant?
They will put seed in their fields and plant vineyards but they will not enjoy the harvest or fruit from them because the worms and the locusts will eat them.
How will the foreigner become more important than the people of Israel?
Foreigners will lend to them while the people of Israel will not be able to lend to the foreigners so will be considered inferior to them.
What will happen because the people of Israel did not listen to the voice of Yahweh and keep his commandments?
All the curses listed will happen to them until they are destroyed.
Why will the people of Israel serve the enemies of Yahweh?
They will serve their enemies because they did not serve Yahweh with joyfulness and gladness of heart when they had abundant blessings.
What did Moses prophesy about the people of Israel?
Yahweh would bring a nation from far away to attack them with no respect for the aged or young, as well as taking their crops and animals, leaving them to starve.
During the siege of the city what will the man who is described not share with even his own family?
He will not give to any of them the flesh of his own children that he is going to eat.
During the siege of the city what will a woman do with her own newborn and the children whom she will bear?
During the siege of the city a woman will eat her own children whom she will bear.
What will happen if the people of Israel do not honor the name of Yahweh by keeping the words in the book of the law?
They will experience terrible plagues and enduring sicknesses.
How many of the people of Israel will be left after Yahweh punishes them?
Although they had been numerous, only a few of them will remain scattered among the other nations.
Will the people of Israel find rest when they are scattered among the nations?
They will find no peace or rest and they will be afraid, hopeless, and mournful.
With whom did Yahweh make a covenant?
Yahweh made a covenant with Israel in the land of Moab.
What previous covenant had Yahweh made with the people of Israel?
Yahweh previously made a covenant with Israel at Horeb.
Of what did Moses remind all the people of Israel?
Moses reminded all them of everything that Yahweh had done in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his servants, and to all his land.
Why did Moses say that the people of Israel needed to be reminded of the great sufferings that their eyes had seen as well as the signs and wonders?
Moses said that until that time, Yahweh had not given them understanding about those things.
Why did Yahweh lead Israel for 40 years in the wilderness where their clothes and sandals did not wear out and they did not eat any bread or drink any wine or alcoholic drinks?
He did those things so that they might know that he is Yahweh their God.
What did Israel need to do in order to prosper in everything?
They needed to keep the words of this covenant so that they might prosper in everything that they did.
Before whom were all of the Israelites standing?
All of the Israelites were standing before Yahweh their God.
Why were the Israelites standing before Yahweh their God?
They were standing before Yahweh in order to enter into the covenant that Yahweh was making with them on that day.
What did Yahweh want to do for the people of Israel through this covenant?
He wanted to make the people of Israel into a people for himself as he had promised their ancestors.
What people were included in the covenant and oath that Yahweh was making with Israel that day in Moab?
Everyone standing that day in Moab and also those who were not there with them were included in the covenant that Yahweh was making with Israel.
About what were the people of Israel being reminded again?
They were being reminded how they had lived in the land of Egypt and how they had traveled through the land that belonged to other people groups after they came out of Egypt.
Why were the people being reminded of the disgusting things they had seen when they left Egypt?
They were being reminded of the disgusting things they had seen so that there would not be any among them whose heart would turn away from Yahweh, worshiping the gods of those nations.
What should the person who hears the words of the curse not say in his heart?
The person who hears the words of the curse should not say that he will have peace even though he stubbornly does what he wants.
What would happen to the man who says that he will have peace even though he stubbornly does what he wants?
Yahweh will not forgive him, Yahweh will be angry with him and all the curses written in the book will happen to him and Yahweh will destroy him and his family forever.
What will the future generations and other nations say when they see the plagues on this land and the diseases which Yahweh has sent on them?
They will say that Yahweh did this to this land and wonder why he was so angry with the people who lived there.
How will people reply when future generations ask why Yahweh did this to the land?

The people will say that Yahweh became very angry and brought these curses on their land because they had abandoned the covenant they had made with Yahweh and because they went and worshiped other gods, gods that they had not worshiped before and that he had told them not to worship.
What will the people say that Yahweh will do in his anger?
The people will say that Yahweh, in his extreme anger, has taken them out of their land and thrown them into another land.
To whom do things that are revealed belong?
The things that are revealed belong forever to the people of Israel and to their descendants so that they may do all the words of the law.
What must the people of Israel do so that Yahweh will rescue them from their captivity and have compassion on them and gather them from all the peoples where Yahweh had scattered them?
They must return to Yahweh and obey his voice, follow all that he has commanded them with all their heart and with all their soul.
From where will Yahweh gather Israel’s scattered people?
Yahweh will gather Israel’s scattered people from the most distant places on earth.
To what place will Yahweh bring the scattered Israelites?
Yahweh will bring them into the land that their ancestors possessed.
Why will Yahweh change the hearts of the Israelites and their descendants?
Yahweh will change their hearts so that they will love Yahweh their God with all their heart and with all of their soul and so that they could live.
On whom will Yahweh put the curses that had been on the people of Israel?
Yahweh will put the curses on their enemies and on those who hate the people of Israel and have oppressed them.
What will Yahweh do when the people of Israel return to him?
Yahweh will make them prosper and he will rejoice over the people of Israel as he rejoiced over their fathers.
What will indicate that the people of Israel have returned to Yahweh?
They will obey the voice of Yahweh and will do all his commandments that Moses commanded them.
What do the people of Israel need to do so that Yahweh will rejoice over them?

The people of Israel need to obey the voice of Yahweh their God, keep his commandments and statutes that were written in the book of the law and turn to Yahweh with all their heart and all their soul.
What does Moses say is not too hard for the people or too far for them to reach?
Moses says that the commandments that he is giving to the people of Israel are not too hard for them to know and obey.
What has Moses placed before the people of Israel?
Moses is allowing them to choose life and good, or death and evil.
What will happen if the people of Israel obey everything Yahweh their God has commanded them?
They will live and multiply and Yahweh will bless them in the land where they were going.
What will happen to the people if they do not listen and obey, but instead they bow down to other gods and worship them?
They will surely perish and they will not live very long in the land.
What is Moses asking the people of Israel to choose as he calls heaven and earth to witness?
Moses is asking the people to choose life so that they and their descendants could live.
Why should the people choose life?

They should choose life so as to love Yahweh their God, to obey his voice and to cling to him because he is their life and will enable them and their descendants to live for a long time in the land that he has given to them.
What did Moses tell all Israel about his advancing age?
He told them that he was now 120 years old and that he could no longer go everywhere that they could go.
What did Yahweh tell Moses about going over the Jordan?
He told Moses that he would not be going over Jordan but God would go over Jordan ahead of them and would destroy the nations there for Israel.
Who did Yahweh say would go over Jordan instead of Moses?
Yahweh told Moses that Joshua would go over the Jordan to lead Israel.
What had Yahweh done to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites?
Yahweh had destroyed them and their land.
What does Yahweh say he will do for Israel when they meet the nations in battle?
Yahweh says that he will enable Israel to conquer them when Israel meets them in battle.
What instruction does Moses give to the Israelites?
Moses tells them to be strong and courageous, not to fear, and not to be afraid of the nations because Yahweh will go with them and will not fail or forsake them.
What did Moses say to Joshua while of all Israel was listening?

Moses told Joshua to be strong and courageous for Joshua would go with the people of Israel into the land that Yahweh swore to their ancestors to give to them and Yahweh will cause them to inherit the land.
What did Moses tell Joshua that Yahweh would do for him?
Moses told Joshua that Yahweh would go before Joshua and be with him, and Yahweh would not fail or abandon Joshua so he should not be afraid or dismayed.
To whom did Moses give the law after he wrote it?
Moses gave this law to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the box and he also gave copies of it to all the elders of Israel.
How often did Moses command the priests to read the law that Moses gave to them?
Moses commanded the priests to read the law at the end of every seven years, during the Festival of Huts, in the hearing of all Israel.
Why did Moses tell the priests to assemble the men, women, children, and foreigners?

Moses told the priests to assemble all the people so that they could hear and learn, and honor Yahweh their God and keep all the words of the law and so that their children could hear and learn to honor Yahweh.
For how long should the priests read the law to the people of Israel?
The priests should read the law to the people for as long as they live in the land that they were going over the Jordan to occupy.
What happen when Moses and Joshua presented themselves in the tent of meeting?
When Moses and Joshua presented themselves in the tent of meeting, Yahweh appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud which stood over the door of the tent.
Why did Yahweh tell Moses to call Joshua and present themselves in the tent of meeting?
Yahweh told Moses to call Joshua to the tent of meeting because the day was coming when Moses must die and Yahweh would appoint Joshua to be the new leader.
What did Yahweh tell Moses he would do when the people break Yahweh’s covenant?
Yahweh told Moses that on the day the people break his covenant, he would be very angry with them and would abandon them, and he would refuse to help them any longer.
How did Yahweh tell Moses the people would act after Moses died?

Yahweh told Moses that the people would become unfaithful to Yahweh and begin to worship the strange gods of the land and that they would forsake Yahweh and break the covenant that he had made with them.
What did Yahweh tell Moses would happen to the people when Yahweh hid his face from them?
Yahweh told Moses that many bad things would happen to them and he would stop protecting them.
Why did Yahweh tell Moses to write a song and teach it to the people of Israel and make them memorize it?
Yahweh told Moses to write a song and teach it to the people so that the song could be a witness for Yahweh against the people of Israel.
What did Yahweh tell Moses the people would do when they were in the land that Yahweh swore to give to their ancestors?
Yahweh told Moses the people of Israel would turn to other gods, worship them, despise Yahweh and break his covenant.
What did Yahweh tell Moses the song would do when many evils and troubles happen to the people of Israel?
Yahweh told Moses that the song would testify before Israel as a witness and it would not be forgotten by their descendants.
What did Yahweh say he knew about the people even before he brought them into the land that he had sworn?
Yahweh said that he knew the plans that the people were already making.
How long did Moses wait before he wrote the song that Yahweh told him to write?
Moses wrote the song on the same day that Yahweh told him to write it and then he taught it to the people of Israel on that same day.
What command did Yahweh give to Joshua, the son of Nun?
Yahweh commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous.
Why did Yahweh command Joshua to be strong and courageous?
Yahweh told Joshua to be strong and courageous because Joshua would bring the people of Israel into the land that Yahweh had sworn to them and Yahweh told Joshua that he would be with Joshua.
To whom did Moses give the words of the law in a book when he had finished writing?
Moses gave the words of the law to the Levites who carried the box of the covenant of Yahweh.
What did Moses tell the Levites that they should do with the book of the law when he finished writing it?
Moses told the Levites to take the book of the law and put is by the side of the box of the covenant of Yahweh their God so that it would be there as a witness against them.
What did Moses tell the Levites he knew about them even while he was still alive?
Moses told the Levites that he knew how they had been and would continue to be rebellious against Yahweh even after his death.
Why did Moses tell the Levites to assemble before him all the elders of their tribes and their officers?
Moses told the Levites to assemble the elders and officers so that he could teach them the song which would be a witness against them.
What does Moses say that he knows will happen after his death?
Moses says that after his death the people will utterly corrupt themselves and turn away from the path that Moses had commanded them.
What does Moses say will happen when the people turn away from the path that Moses had commanded them?
Moses says that disaster will come on the people in the following days after they turn away from the path that Moses had commanded them.
Why does Moses say disaster will come to the people?
Moses says disaster will come when Yahweh will become very angry because of the evil things they will do.
What did Moses sing for all the assembly of Israel to hear?
Moses sang all the words of the song he had written.
What is Moses asking the heavens and the earth to do?
Moses is asking all who are in the heavens and on the earth to listen to the words of his mouth as he sings this song.
To what does Moses compare his teaching and his speech?
Moses compares his teaching to rain and his speech to dew because of the refreshment they bring.
To what name does Moses proclaim and ascribe greatness?
Moses proclaims the name of Yahweh and ascribes greatness to God.
Whose works are perfect and paths are just?
The work of Yahweh, the Rock, is perfect and his ways are just.
Who has no iniquity and is righteous and upright?
God is faithful, has no iniquity, and is righteous and upright.
What does Moses call the people who have acted corruptly against Yahweh?
Moses calls them a perverse and crooked generation and foolish people without wisdom.
Who does Moses say made and established the people of Israel?
Moses says that Yahweh made and established the people of Israel.
Of what does Moses say the fathers and elders will be able to remind the Israelites?
Moses says that the fathers and elders will be able to remind the Israelites about what happened to their ancestors.
What is Yahweh’s portion and inheritance?
Yahweh’s portion and inheritance are Jacob’s descendants, those who he chose to be his people.
Where did Yahweh find his people (Jacob)?
Yahweh found Jacob in a desert land.
What did Yahweh do for his people (Jacob)?
Yahweh protected them, watched over them, and cared for them.
To what does Moses compare the way that Yahweh took care of his people?
Moses compares the way that Yahweh took care of his people to an eagle who guards her nest and hovers over her young.
Who alone led the people of Israel?
Yahweh alone led the people of Israel.
What happened when Jeshurun (Israel) grew prosperous?
When Jeshurun (Israel) grew prosperous and satisfied they abandoned and rejected Yahweh and made him jealous and angry by worshiping strange gods and idols.
Who did God’s people forget when they continued to rebel?
They forgot the God who gave them birth.
What did Yahweh do because his people provoked him?
Yahweh rejected his people because of their unfaithfulness.
Who will Yahweh use to make Israel angry in return for making him angry?
Yahweh will make them angry by a nation that has no understanding.
What did Yahweh say he would cause to happen to Israel?
Yahweh said he would cause many disasters to happen to them.
What would keep Yahweh from doing all that he threatened to his people?
Yahweh would keep from doing all that he threatened to his people because their enemies would mistakenly think they were stronger than Israel.
Of what was Israel lacking as a nation?
Israel was lacking sense and there was no understanding in them.
What does Moses want for Israel to consider?
Moses wants Israel to understand why Yahweh would punish them and what would happen to them.
How is it that Israel can be defeated by their enemies?
Israel could only be defeated by their enemies if Yahweh had given their enemies power to defeat them.
From where does the vine of the enemy come and how are the grapes described?
Their vine comes from Sodom and Gomorrah because their gods are as deeply evil theirs and the grapes from that vine are poisonous and bitter.
How is the plan of Yahweh concealed?
Yahweh’s plan is concealed with him and sealed up and protected among his treasures.
To whom does vengeance and recompense belong?
Vengeance and recompense belongs to Yahweh.
How soon may the day of disaster and the things that are to come happen?
Disaster is near and the things to come will hurry to happen.
Who will make decisions for his people and have pity on his servants?
Yahweh will decide for his people and he will pity his servants.
From whom does help and protection not come for the people of Israel?
Protection and help does not come from the gods, the rock in whom they took refuge and who ate their sacrifices and drank their drink offerings.
Who does God say is a god besides him and what does God alone say that he can do?
God says that there is no god besides him and he alone will kill and make alive, wound and heal.
What does God, who alone is God promise as he lifts up his hand to heaven?
As he lifts his hand to heaven he promises that as he lives forever, he will act.
On whom will God bring justice and render vengeance?
God will bring justice and render vengeance on his enemies and those who hate him.
From whom does God say that his arrows be drunk with blood and his sword devour flesh?
God’s arrows will be drunk with the blood of the killed and captives and his sword will devour flesh from the heads of the leaders of the enemy.
Who will rejoice with God’s people when he avenges the blood of his servants and brings vengeance on his enemies?
The nations will rejoice with God’s people.
For whom will God make atonement for his land?
God will make atonement for his land, for his people.
Who sang all the words of this song in the ears of the people?
Moses and Joshua sang this song in the ears of the people.
Why are the people of Israel to fix their minds on the words that Moses has witnessed to them?
The people are to fix their minds on Moses’ words so they could command their children to keep all the words of this law.
Why did Yahweh tell Moses to go up into the mountains opposite Jericho?
Yahweh told Moses to go up to the mountains so that he could look at the land of Canaan which Yahweh was giving to the people of Israel as their possession.
Why did Yahweh say that Moses was going to die on the mountain?
Moses was going to die on the mountain because he was unfaithful to Yahweh at the waters of Meribah in Kadesh and because Moses did not treat Yahweh with honor and respect among the people of Israel.
What does Yahweh say will happen to Moses on the mountain?
Yahweh says that Moses will die on the mountain as Aaron had died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
What did Yahweh say that Moses would see before his death?
Yahweh said that Moses would see the land that Yahweh was giving to the people of Israel but he would not go there.
When did Moses give this blessing to the people of Israel?
Moses gave this blessing to the people of Israel before his death.
Moses describes Yahweh as coming like the sun rising over Mount Seir, who shone out from Mount Paran, who came with thousands of holy angels, and there was a flaming fire at his right side.
How does Yahweh feel about the people of Israel?
Yahweh loves the people of Israel.
How do the holy people of Israel respond to the love of Yahweh?
The people of Israel will worship at Yahweh’s feet and receive Yahweh’s words.
What does Moses say about the law that he commanded to the people?
Moses calls the law a possession for the descendants of Jacob.
What did Yahweh become when the heads of the people and all the tribes of Israel had gathered?
What did Moses say would happen to Reuben?
Moses said that Reuben would live and not die but his men would be few.
What is the blessing that Moses gives to Judah?
Moses asks Yahweh to bless Judah by listening and helping him against his enemies and bringing him home safely.
What does Moses tell Levi to do in his blessing?
Moses tells the Levi to keep Yahweh’s covenant, teach his laws to Israel, put incense and burnt offerings on Yahweh’s altar.
What does Moses say about Benjamin in his blessing?
Yahweh says that Benjamin is the one loved by Yahweh who he keeps safe and protects.
Who was prince over his brothers?
Joseph was prince over his brothers.
What will Ephraim and Manasseh do together?
They will push other people groups to the most places on earth.
From where does Moses say the blessings of Zebulun and Issachar will come?
The blessings of Zebulun and Issachar will come from the abundance of the seas and the sand.
How does Moses say Gad will live as his territory is enlarged?
Gad will live there like a lioness ready to attach his enemies.
What did Gad carry out for Yahweh?
Gad carried out the justice of Yahweh and his judgments with Israel.
Moses described Dan as a lion cub that leaps out from Bashan.
What land did Moses say Naphtali will take?
Naphtali will take possession of the land to the west and south.
What does Moses say about Asher in his blessing?
Moses says that Asher will be more blessed than the other sons, that he produce a lot of olive oil, and that he will be strong and secure as long as he lives.
What did Moses say God will do to Israel’s enemies?
Moses said God would drive out Israel’s enemies from before them.
Israel will live safely and securely in a land of grain and new wine.
Moses describes Israel as a people saved by Yahweh, whose enemies will come begging to them.
From where was Moses shown all the lands that the tribes of Israel would possess?
Moses was shown all the land that the tribes of Israel would posses from the top of Pisgah.
What did Yahweh allow Moses to see before he died?
Yahweh allowed Moses to see the land that Yahweh promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Where did Moses die and where did Yahweh bury Moses?
Moses died in the land of Moab and Yahweh buried him in the valley, in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor.
What was Moses physical condition when he died at 120 years of age?
When Moses died he was still strong and could see well.
How long did the people of Israel mourn for Moses?
The people mourned for Moses for 30 days.
Why did the people of Israel listen to Joshua and do what Yahweh had commanded Moses?
The people of Israel listened to Joshua because Joshua was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him.
Has there ever been a prophet like Moses in Israel?
There has never been any other prophet like Moses in all of Israel.
How was Moses known by Yahweh?
Yahweh knew Moses face to face.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua to do after the death of Moses?
Yahweh told Joshua to arise, cross the Jordan River with all the people, and go into the land he was giving to the sons of Israel.
Why did Yahweh say that no one would be able to stand against Joshua?
Yahweh said that no one would be able to stand against Joshua because Yahweh would be with Joshua just as he had been with Moses.
What did Yahweh ask Joshua to do regarding the law of Moses?
Yahweh asked Joshua to be strong and very courageous, and to be careful to do according to all the law that Moses commanded, not turning from it to the right or to the left.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua he should meditate on day and night?
Yahweh told Joshua that the book of the law should not depart from his mouth, but he should meditate on it day and night.
What did Joshua tell the officers of the people to command the people?
Joshua told the officers to command the people to prepare provisions for themselves because within three days they would cross the Jordan to possess the land Yahweh was giving them.
What did Joshua remind the people that Moses had said Yahweh would give them?
Joshua reminded the people that Moses had said, “Yahweh your God is giving rest to you, and he will give to you this land.”
What did Joshua tell the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh to do?

Joshua told them that their wives, children, and livestock could remain in the land Moses had given them east of the Jordan, but all their warriors, being armed, should cross over to help their brothers.
How did the people answer Joshua’s commands?
The people answered Joshua by saying they would do all that he had commanded them and go wherever he sent them.
Where did the two spies stay when Joshua sent them to see the land and Jericho?
The two spies stayed at the house of a prostitute named Rahab in Jericho.
What did Rahab do with the two spies when the king of Jericho sent men to find them?
When the king’s men came to Rahab looking for the spies, she had hidden the spies, and she denied knowing where they were.
What did Rahab tell the men from the king of Jericho about the spies?

Rahab told the king’s men that the spies had come to her, but she did not know where they were from, and they left at dark when the gate was about to shut. She told the men to pursue them quickly to overtake them.
What reason did Rahab give the spies for why she had hidden them?
Rahab told the spies that she knew Yahweh had given them the land and that the dread of them had fallen on her people.
What reports had made Rahab believe Yahweh had given the Israelites the land?

Rahab said she believed Yahweh had given the Israelites the land because she had heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Sea of Reeds for them and what they did to the two Amorite kings, Sihon and Og.
What did Rahab ask the spies to do for her and her family?
Rahab asked the spies to swear by Yahweh that they would keep her father, mother, brothers, sisters, and all their households alive and deliver them from death.
What did the spies promise Rahab?
The spies promised Rahab that their lives would be given in place of hers if she did not tell about their mission, and they would deal kindly and faithfully with her when Yahweh gave them the land.
What did the spies tell Rahab she must do for her and her family to be safe when they came into the land?
The spies told Rahab to tie a scarlet cord in the window and gather her father, mother, brothers, and all her father’s household into her house.
What did the spies report to Joshua when they returned?
The spies told Joshua that Yahweh had given all the land into their hand and that all the inhabitants of the land were melting because of them.
What did the officers tell the people to do when they saw the Levite priests carrying the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh?
The officers told the people that when they saw the Box of the Covenant and the priests carrying it, they should set out from their place and follow it.
Why did the officers tell the people to stay about 2,000 cubits behind the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh?
The officers told the people to stay that far behind the Box of the Covenant so they would know the way to go, since they had not passed that way before.
What did Joshua say Yahweh was going to do among the people the next day?
Joshua said that Yahweh was going to do wonders for the people the next day.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua to command the priests carrying the Box of the Covenant when they reached the edge of the Jordan River?
Yahweh told Joshua to command the priests to stand still in the Jordan River once they reached the edge of its waters.
What did Joshua tell the people would happen when the soles of the feet of the priests carrying the Box of Yahweh rested in the waters of the Jordan?
Joshua told the people that as soon as the soles of the priests’ feet rested in the Jordan’s waters, the waters flowing from above would be cut off and stand in one heap.
Where did the people cross the Jordan River?
The people crossed the Jordan opposite Jericho, while the waters from above stood in a heap far away at Adam.
What did the priests who carried the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh do while all Israel crossed the Jordan?
The priests who carried the Box of the Covenant stood firmly on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan River until all the nation had finished crossing.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua to command 12 men (one from each tribe) to do?
Yahweh told Joshua to command the 12 men to take 12 stones from the middle of the Jordan, from where the priests’ feet stood, and carry them to their lodging place.
What did Joshua say was the purpose of the 12 stones taken from the Jordan River?
The stones would be a memorial to the people of Israel forever, because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh when it crossed.
About how many armed warriors crossed over before Yahweh to the plains of Jericho for battle?
About 40,000 armed warriors crossed over before Yahweh to the plains of Jericho for battle.
What happened when the priests who carried the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh came up out of the Jordan and their feet touched dry ground?
When the priests’ feet touched dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks as before.
Where did Joshua set up the 12 stones that the men had taken out of the Jordan?
At Gilgal Joshua set up the 12 stones that came out of the Jordan.
Why did Joshua say the people should tell their children what Yahweh had done for them at the Jordan?
Joshua said they should tell their children so that all the peoples of the earth might know Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and so that they might fear Yahweh their God all the days.
What was the reaction of the Amorite and Canaanite kings when they heard Yahweh had dried up the Jordan’s waters for Israel?
When the kings heard how Yahweh had dried up the Jordan’s waters, their hearts melted, and there was no longer any spirit in them because of the sons of Israel.
What did Yahweh command Joshua to make and do a second time for the sons of Israel?
Yahweh commanded Joshua to make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel a second time.
Why did Joshua have to circumcise the sons of those who came out of Egypt?
Joshua had to circumcise them because they were uncircumcised, as they had not been circumcised while they were traveling in the wilderness.
What festival did the sons of Israel celebrate while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho?
While camped at Gilgal, the sons of Israel celebrated the Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month.
What food stopped the day after the people of Israel ate the produce of the land of Canaan?
The manna stopped the day after they ate the produce of the land, and the sons of Israel no longer had manna.
Who did Joshua see standing in front of him with a drawn sword when he was by Jericho?
Joshua saw a man standing in front of him with his drawn sword in his hand.
Who did the man with the drawn sword say he was?
The man with the drawn sword told Joshua that he had come as the commander of the army of Yahweh.
What did Joshua ask the commander of Yahweh’s army?
Joshua fell on his face to the earth, bowed down, and asked what his lord was speaking to his servant.
What did the commander of Yahweh’s army tell Joshua to do because the place on which he was standing was holy?
The commander of Yahweh’s army told Joshua to remove his sandals from his feet because the place on which he was standing was holy.
What did Yahweh promise Joshua concerning Jericho, its king, and its warriors?
Yahweh promised Joshua that he had given Jericho, its king, and its warriors into Joshua’s hand.
How were the men of war to circle the city of Jericho for six days?
All the men of war were to circle the city, going around it one time each day for six days.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua should happen on the seventh day involving priests, shofars, and the people?

Yahweh told him that seven priests should carry seven shofars before the Box, and on the seventh day the people should circle the city seven times while the priests blew the shofars; then, at a long blast, all the people should shout.
What did Yahweh say would happen to the city wall when the people shouted on the seventh day?
Yahweh said the wall of the city would collapse unto itself, and the people should go up, every man straight into the city.
What did Joshua command the people not to do until he told them to shout?
Joshua commanded the people not to shout, nor let their voice be heard, nor let a word go out of their mouth until the day he told them to shout.
Who did Joshua say would live when the city of Jericho was devoted to Yahweh, and why?
Joshua said that only Rahab the prostitute and all who were with her in her house would live, because she hid the messengers they sent.
What did Joshua declare was holy to Yahweh and must enter Yahweh’s treasury?
Joshua declared that all the silver, gold, and objects of bronze and iron were holy to Yahweh and must enter Yahweh’s treasury.
What did the people of Israel do to everything in the city after the walls of Jericho fell?
The people of Israel devoted to destruction by the sword all that was in the city—men and women, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.
What did Joshua command the two men who had spied out the land to do regarding Rahab?
Joshua commanded the two spies to go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out, and all who belonged to her, as they had sworn to her.
What curse did Joshua pronounce on the man who would rebuild Jericho?
Joshua said that the man who rebuilt Jericho would be cursed before Yahweh: he would lay its foundation with his firstborn and set up its gates with his youngest son.
Why did Yahweh’s anger burn against the sons of Israel after Jericho?
Yahweh’s anger burned against the sons of Israel because Achan, from the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things.
What did the spies who went to Ai report back to Joshua about its people?
The spies reported to Joshua not to make all the people go up, but that about 2,000 or 3,000 men should strike Ai, because its people were few.
What happened when about 3,000 men from Israel attacked Ai?
The men of Ai struck down about 36 of the Israelite men, pursued them from the gate to the quarries, and struck them on the descent.
What did Joshua and the elders of Israel do until evening after the defeat at Ai?
Joshua tore his garments and fell on his face to the earth before the Box of Yahweh until evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua was the reason Israel was defeated at Ai and could not stand before their enemies?
Yahweh told Joshua that Israel had sinned by transgressing his covenant, taking from the devoted things, stealing, deceiving, and putting it among their own things.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua to do to prepare the people for the next day?
Yahweh told Joshua to arise, consecrate the people, and tell them to consecrate themselves for the next day because there was a devoted thing in their midst.
What did Yahweh say would happen to the one caught with the devoted thing?
Yahweh said that the one caught with the devoted thing, he and all that belonged to him, would be burned with fire, because he transgressed Yahweh’s covenant and did a disgraceful thing in Israel.
What items did Achan confess to Joshua that he had taken from the spoil?
Achan confessed he had taken a good coat from Shinar, 200 shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing 50 shekels.
Where did Achan tell Joshua he had hidden the things he had taken?
Achan told Joshua he had hidden them in the earth in the middle of his tent, with the silver underneath.
Where did Joshua and all Israel take Achan, his family, his possessions, and the stolen items?
Joshua and all Israel took Achan and all that he had to the Valley of Achor.
What happened to Yahweh’s burning anger after Achan and his household were stoned and burned?
After Achan was dealt with, Yahweh turned from his burning anger.
What instructions did Yahweh give Joshua for attacking Ai, including what to do with its spoil?

Yahweh told Joshua not to fear, to take all the men of war, go up to Ai, set an ambush behind the city, and do to Ai and its king as he did to Jericho, but they could take its spoil and livestock for themselves.
What were the people of Israel allowed to do with the spoil and livestock from Ai, unlike Jericho?
Yahweh told the people they could plunder the spoil and livestock of Ai for themselves.
How many warriors did Joshua choose and send by night for the ambush of Ai?
Joshua chose 30,000 men, warriors of valor, and sent them out by night.
What was Joshua’s plan for his main forces when they approached Ai and the men of Ai came out?
Joshua planned that he and all the people with him would approach the city, and when the men of Ai came out to meet them as before, they would flee.
What were Joshua’s men in ambush to do to the city once they captured it, according to Yahweh’s word?
When the men captured the city, they were to burn it with fire, according to the word of Yahweh.
What did all the people of Ai and Bethel do when Joshua and his army pretended to be beaten and fled toward the wilderness?
All the people in Ai were summoned to pursue Joshua’s army; they pursued Joshua, were drawn away from the city, and left the city open, as did the men of Bethel.
What signal did Yahweh tell Joshua to give with his curved sword to initiate the ambush?
Yahweh told Joshua to stretch out the curved sword in his hand toward Ai, because he would give it into Joshua’s hand.
Who did the men of Israel capture alive from Ai and bring to Joshua?
The men of Israel captured the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
How long did Joshua keep his hand stretched out with the curved sword?
Joshua did not draw back his hand with which he stretched out the curved sword until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai.
What did Israel plunder for themselves from Ai, according to Yahweh’s command to Joshua?
Israel plundered the livestock and the spoil of Ai for themselves, according to the word of Yahweh which he had commanded Joshua.
What did Joshua do with the king of Ai after hanging him on a tree until evening?
As the sun was going down, Joshua commanded, and they took his corpse down from the tree, threw it at the entrance of the city gate, and raised over it a great pile of stones.
What did the kings beyond the Jordan in the hill country, the lowlands, and the coast of the Great Sea do when they heard about Israel’s victories?
The kings gathered themselves together as one to fight against Joshua and against Israel.
Which inhabitants acted with cunning when they heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai?
The inhabitants of Gibeon acted with cunning when they heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
How did the Gibeonite envoys disguise themselves and their provisions to appear as if from a distant land?
They took worn-out sacks, worn-out and mended wine skins, wore worn-out and patched sandals and garments, and took dry, crumbly bread.
What did the Gibeonites tell Joshua and the men of Israel they had come from when they arrived at Gilgal?
The Gibeonites told Joshua and the men of Israel that they had come from a distant land.
What did the Gibeonites ask Joshua and the men of Israel to do?
The Gibeonites asked the men of Israel to make a covenant with them.
What did the Israelite men fail to do before taking the Gibeonites’ provisions and making a covenant?
The Israelite men took some of their provisions but did not ask for the mouth (counsel) of Yahweh.
What did Joshua do with the Gibeonites, and what did the leaders of the congregation do?
Joshua made peace with them and made a covenant with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore to them.
What did the Israelites learn about the Gibeonites three days after making the covenant?
The Israelites learned that the Gibeonites were their neighbors and lived among them.
Why did all the leaders say the Israelites could not attack the Gibeonites?
The leaders said they could not touch the Gibeonites because they had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel.
What reason did the Gibeonites give Joshua for deceiving the Israelites?

The Gibeonites said they deceived the Israelites because it was declared to them that Yahweh had commanded Moses to give Israel all the land and destroy its inhabitants, and they were very afraid for their lives.
What did Joshua decree concerning the Gibeonites, saving them from death but making them serve Israel?
Joshua delivered them from the hand of the sons of Israel so they did not kill them, but he made them cutters of wood and drawers of water for the congregation and for the altar of Yahweh.
Why did Adoni Zedek, king of Jerusalem, and his people fear greatly when they heard Gibeon made peace with Israel?
They feared greatly because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, larger than Ai, and all its men were warriors.
What did Adoni Zedek, king of Jerusalem, ask the kings of Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon to do?
He asked them to come up to him and help him so they could strike Gibeon, because it had made peace with Joshua and Israel.
What did the five Amorite kings (of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon) and their armies do?
The five Amorite kings and all their camps gathered and went up; they camped against Gibeon and fought against it.
What message did the men of Gibeon send to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal?

The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua, asking him not to withdraw his hand from them, but to come up quickly, save them, and help them, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country had gathered against them.
What did Yahweh say to Joshua regarding the five Amorite kings and their armies?
Yahweh told Joshua not to be afraid of them, because he had given them into Joshua’s hand, and not a man from them would stand before him.
How did Yahweh cause more of the fleeing Amorites to die than the Israelites killed with the sword?
As they fled, Yahweh threw great stones from the heavens on them as far as Azekah, and they died; more died from the hailstones than the sons of Israel killed with the sword.
What did Joshua say in the sight of Israel on the day Yahweh gave the Amorites into their hands?
He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, be still over Gibeon, and moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
Where did the five Amorite kings flee and hide themselves?
The five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
What happened to most of the armies of the five Amorite kings?
Joshua and the sons of Israel finished striking them with a very great slaughter until they were finished, and the survivors entered the fortified cities.
What did Joshua do with the five Amorite kings after bringing them out of the cave at Makkedah?

Joshua struck them, killed them, and hanged them on five trees until evening; then, at sunset, they were taken down, thrown into the cave where they had hidden, and great stones were placed over the cave’s mouth.
What did Joshua do to all the land (hill country, Negev, lowland, slopes) and its kings?
Joshua struck all the land and all their kings; he left no survivor but devoted every breathing thing, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded.
Why was Joshua able to capture all these kings and their land at one time?
Joshua was able to capture all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
What did Jabin, king of Hazor, do when he heard about Israel’s victories?
When Jabin, king of Hazor, heard, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph, and to other northern kings.
Where did all these northern kings and their many armies meet and camp to fight against Israel?
All these kings met together and came and camped together at the waters of Merom to fight with Israel.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua not to fear and what to do to their horses and chariots?
Yahweh told Joshua not to be afraid of them, for the next day he would give them all slain to Israel; Joshua was to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.
What did Joshua’s army do to every person in Hazor and to the city itself?
They struck every person in Hazor with the edge of the sword, devoting them; not any breathing thing remained, and Joshua burned Hazor with fire.
What did Joshua do with all the cities of these northern kings and all their kings?
Joshua captured all the cities of these kings and all their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, devoting them, just as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded.
How completely did Joshua follow the commands Yahweh had given Moses, and Moses had given him?
Just as Yahweh had commanded Moses his servant, so Moses had commanded Joshua, and thus Joshua did; he did not turn aside a thing from all that Yahweh had commanded Moses.
Which city was the only one, apart from the Hivite dwellers of Gibeon, that made peace with the sons of Israel?
There was not a city that made peace with the sons of Israel except the Hivites, the dwellers of Gibeon; they captured all of them in battle.
Which kings of the land on the east side of the Jordan did the sons of Israel strike and possess their land?
The sons of Israel struck Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan and possessed their land on the east side of the Jordan.
Who had led the sons of Israel in defeating these kings on the east side of the Jordan, and to whom was their land given?
Moses, the servant of Yahweh, and the sons of Israel had struck them; and Moses gave their land as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Who led the sons of Israel in defeating the kings on the west side of the Jordan, and to whom was their land given?
Joshua and the sons of Israel struck the kings on the west side of the Jordan, and Joshua gave their land to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions.
How many kings in total did Joshua and the sons of Israel strike on the west side of the Jordan?
All the kings on the west side of the Jordan were 31.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua when Joshua was old and advanced in days?
Yahweh told Joshua that he had aged and come into days, and very much land still remained to be possessed.
What did Yahweh say he himself would do to the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, and what was Joshua to do with that land?
Yahweh said he himself would dispossess them from before the sons of Israel, and Joshua was to cause it to fall to Israel as an inheritance.
Among which tribes was Joshua to divide the remaining land as an inheritance?
Joshua was to divide the land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Which tribes had already received their inheritance from Moses on the east side of the Jordan?
With the other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had taken their inheritance that Moses gave them on the other side of the Jordan eastward.
Which tribe did Moses not give an inheritance of land to?
Moses did not give an inheritance to the tribe of Levi.
What was the inheritance of the tribe of Levi, since Moses did not give them land?
Their inheritance was the burnt offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, just as he spoke to them.
What geographical feature formed the border of the inheritance of the sons of Reuben?
The Jordan River and its border formed the border of the inheritance of the sons of Reuben.
The sons of Joseph became which two tribes, who received land, while the Levites received cities?
The sons of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave no portion to the Levites in the land except cities to dwell in and pasturelands.
How old was Caleb when Moses sent him from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land?
Caleb was 40 years old when Moses, the servant of Yahweh, sent him from Kadesh Barnea to spy on the land.
What did Moses swear on that day concerning the land Caleb’s foot had trodden?
Moses swore that the land on which Caleb’s foot had trodden would be an inheritance for Caleb and his sons forever, because he was full after Yahweh his God.
How old was Caleb when he spoke to Joshua about his inheritance, 45 years after Yahweh spoke to Moses?
Caleb was 85 years old at that time.
What specific hill country did Caleb ask Joshua to give him, which Yahweh had spoken of, where Anakites and fortified cities were?
Caleb asked Joshua to give him the hill country that Yahweh spoke of on that day, where the Anakites were with great fortified cities.
Where was the lot for the tribe of Judah according to their clans, extending southward?
The lot for the tribe of Judah was to the border of Edom, from the wilderness of Zin southward from the end of the south.
What was the eastern border for the tribe of Judah?
The eastern border for the tribe of Judah was the Sea of Salt, up to the end of the Jordan River.
What was the western border for the clans of the sons of Judah?
The western border for the clans of the sons of Judah was the Great Sea and its border.
What did Caleb give his daughter Achsah in addition to the land of the Negev when she asked for a blessing?
When Achsah asked for springs of water, Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
Which people, dwelling in Jerusalem, were the sons of Judah not able to dispossess?
The sons of Judah were not able to dispossess the Jebusites, the dwellers of Jerusalem, so the Jebusites have dwelled with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.
Which two tribes, the sons of Joseph, inherited land?
The sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, inherited land.
Which Canaanite dwellers of Gezer did the Ephraimites not dispossess, who then lived among them as forced laborers?
The Ephraimites did not dispossess the Canaanite dwellers of Gezer, so the Canaanites have dwelled within Ephraim to this day but have become serving forced laborers.
Who was the firstborn of Joseph, to whom a lot was given?
Manasseh was the firstborn of Joseph, and a lot was given to him.
Who was Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead, and what did he receive because he was a man of war?
Machir was the firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead; because he was a man of war, Gilead and Bashan were given to him.
Why did the daughters of Zelophehad approach Eleazar, Joshua, and the leaders?
The daughters of Zelophehad approached them because their father had no sons, and Yahweh had commanded Moses to give them an inheritance among their father’s brothers.
What did Joshua (Eleazar and the leaders) give to the daughters of Zelophehad according to Yahweh’s command?
They gave them an inheritance in the midst of the brothers of their father, according to the command of Yahweh.
What did the sons of Israel do to the Canaanites when they became strong, though they did not dispossess them?
When the sons of Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but they did not dispossess them.
What did the sons of Joseph say to Joshua about their inheritance, since they were a numerous people blessed by Yahweh?
The sons of Joseph asked Joshua why he had given them only one lot and one portion as an inheritance, when they were a numerous people whom Yahweh had blessed.
What did Joshua tell the numerous sons of Joseph to do if the hill country of Ephraim was too narrow for them?
Joshua told them that if they were a numerous people, they should go up to the forest and clear land for themselves there in the land of the Perizzites and the Raphaites.
How many tribes remained among the sons of Israel which had not yet occupied any land?
Seven tribes remained among the sons of Israel which had not yet divided their inheritance.
What did Joshua instruct each of the seven remaining tribes to provide for surveying the land?
Joshua instructed them to provide three men from each tribe to arise and walk about in the land and write down a description of it.
What were the men sent to survey the land supposed to write down and bring back to Joshua?
They were to write down a description of the land according to their inheritance and then come back to Joshua.
What did Joshua do at Shiloh before Yahweh after the surveyors returned, to divide the land for the remaining tribes?
Joshua threw a lot for them in Shiloh before Yahweh, and there Joshua divided the land to the sons of Israel according to their divisions.
Between which two tribes’ territories did the lot for the tribe of Benjamin fall?
The border of the lot for the tribe of Benjamin went out between the sons of Judah and between the sons of Joseph.
To which tribe, according to their clans, did the second lot come out?
The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans.
From which tribe’s portion was the inheritance of the sons of Simeon taken?
The leaders of Israel had assigned more land to the tribe of Judah than it needed, so they gave part of that land to the tribe of Simeon.
Why was the inheritance of Simeon taken from Judah’s portion?
It was taken from Judah’s portion because the division of the sons of Judah was too great for them, so the sons of Simeon inherited in the midst of their inheritance.
To which tribe, according to their clans, did the third lot come up?
The third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their clans.
To which tribe, according to their clans, did the fourth lot come out?
Joshua threw the lot again, and this time it selected the clans of the tribe of Issachar to receive the fourth part of the land.
To which tribe, according to their clans, did the fifth lot come out?
Joshua threw the lot again, and this time it selected the clans of the tribe of Asher to receive the fifth part of the land.
When Joshua threw the lot again, which tribe did it select to receive the sixth part of the land?
The sixth lot came out for the sons of Naphtali, for the sons of Naphtali according to their clans.
How many fortified cities and their villages were included in the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali?
The inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali included 19 cities and their villages.
To which tribe, according to their clans, did the seventh lot come out?
The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans.
What city did the sons of Israel give to Joshua son of Nun as an inheritance in their midst, upon Yahweh’s command?
Upon the mouth of Yahweh, they gave him the city that he requested, Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim.
What did Yahweh tell Joshua to instruct the sons of Israel to designate, as spoken by Moses?
Yahweh told Joshua to instruct the sons of Israel to choose some cities to which people can flee in order to be safe, as he spoke to them by the hand of Moses.
For whom were the cities of refuge intended as a sanctuary?
They were intended for the one killing by striking a person by mistake without intent, to be a refuge from the avenger of blood.
What was a person who fled to a city of refuge to do at the entrance of the city gate, and how were the elders to respond?
The person was to stand at the entrance of the city gate and speak his words in the ears of the elders of that city; they were to gather him into the city and give him a place to dwell with them.
How long was the one who killed someone by mistake to dwell in the city of refuge before returning to his own city and house?
He was to dwell in that city until his standing before the congregation for judgment, and he must still stay there until the current high priest dies.
What did the heads of the fathers of the Levites ask Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the Israelite tribes at Shiloh?
They asked for cities to dwell in, with their pasturelands for their livestock, as Yahweh had commanded by the hand of Moses.
How did the sons of Israel give cities and pasturelands to the Levites from their inheritance?
The sons of Israel gave these cities and their pasturelands to the Levites by lot from their inheritance, just as Yahweh had commanded by the hand of Moses.
How many cities in total, from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin, were given by lot to the sons of Aaron the priest?
All the cities of the sons of Aaron, the priests, were 13 cities and their pasturelands.
How many cities in total, from Ephraim, Dan, and half-Manasseh, were given to the remaining clans of the sons of Kohath?
There were ten cities in all, together with their surrounding fields, that these other clans that were descendants of Kohath received.
How many cities in total, from half-Manasseh (in Bashan), Issachar, Asher, and Naphtali, were given to the clans of Gershon?
Altogether, the Gershonite clans received 13 cities, together with their surrounding fields.
How many cities in total, from Zebulun, Reuben, and Gad, were given by lot to the clans of Merari, the remaining Levites?
In all, this last group of Levite clans, the ones that were descendants of Merari, received 12 cities when the Israelite leaders cast lots for them.
How many cities in total, with their pasturelands, did the Levites receive in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel?
All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were 48 cities and their pasturelands.
What did Yahweh give to Israel from all around, according to all he had sworn to their fathers, and what happened to their enemies?

Yahweh gave rest to them from all around, according to all that he had sworn to their fathers. None of their enemies were able to fight against them and defeat them. Instead, Yahweh helped Israel defeat all their enemies.
What did Joshua commend the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh for having kept for many days?
Joshua commended them for not forsaking their fellow Israelites but having kept everything that Yahweh their God taught them and commanded them to do.
What did Joshua tell the departing tribes (Reuben, Gad, half-Manasseh) to do with the great spoil of their enemies?
Joshua told them to return to their tents with many riches, livestock, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and garments, and to divide the spoil of their enemies with their brothers.
What did the sons of Israel hear that the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh had built near the Jordan in Canaan?
The sons of Israel heard that these tribes had built an altar at the front of the land of Canaan, in the regions of the Jordan, on the side of the sons of Israel.
What did the whole congregation of the sons of Israel do at Shiloh when they heard about the altar?
The whole congregation of the sons of Israel gathered themselves at Shiloh to go up against them to war.
Who did the sons of Israel send to the land of Gilead to speak with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-Manasseh?
The sons of Israel sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the land of Gilead.
What accusation of unfaithfulness did the whole congregation of Yahweh make against the tribes who built the altar?
They asked what unfaithfulness these tribes had committed against the God of Israel, to turn away from Yahweh by building an altar for themselves in rebellion against Yahweh.
What did the messengers fear would happen tomorrow if these tribes rebelled against Yahweh today?
They feared that if these tribes rebelled against Yahweh today, then tomorrow Yahweh would be furious toward all the congregation of Israel.
Regarding future generations, what did the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-Manasseh say was the purpose of building the altar?

They said they built the altar to be a witness between them and the other tribes, and between their future generations, to serve Yahweh with their offerings, so their sons would not tell the other tribes’ sons they had no portion in Yahweh.
How did Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the congregation react to the explanation given by these tribes about the altar?
When Phinehas the priest and the leaders heard their words, it was good in their eyes.
What was the reaction of the sons of Israel when Phinehas and the leaders reported the explanation for the altar?
